title: Zesty Filipino Pork Skewers
description: A funky and chewy Filipino dish featuring tomato sauce and sous-vide cooking, perfect for a festive occasion, and keto-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together tomato sauce, fish sauce, apple cider vinegar, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the sous-vide machine and cook for 2 hours.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Remove the skewers from the sous-vide machine and sear in the skillet for 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with minced garlic and a side of cauliflower rice.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
